name: Harbor View Hotel - Martha's Vineyard
positioning: Seaside hotel in Edgartown on Martha's Vineyard, opened in 1891 and restored and redesigned in 2019, overlooking Edgartown Harbor and Edgartown Lighthouse
best_for: Travelers who want harbor views and a walkable base steps from Edgartown Village and its beaches
Families who want a stand-alone cottage with a kitchenette and living room

facts.text: The Harbor View Hotel is in Edgartown, on Martha's Vineyard, about 7 miles off the coast of Massachusetts.
The hotel is steps from Fuller and Lighthouse Beaches, shopping in Edgartown Village and the natural habitat of Chappaquiddick Island.
The Harbor View Hotel opened in July 1891.
The hotel was restored and redesigned in 2019.
Guests choose between three building types: the grand historic building, The Roxana and the Captain's Cottages.
Every room has Frette linens, a Nespresso coffee machine, robes, WiFi and wireless speakers.
The hotel has a heated, saltwater outdoor pool, a fitness center and bicycles for guest use.
The hotel's Veranda overlooks Edgartown Harbor.
Couples say their vows on the hotel's Great Lawn.
Bettini Restaurant serves contemporary American cuisine, with expansive windows onto the coastal view.
Behind The View has harbor views and access to an outdoor veranda.

highlights.text: The fourth-floor Presidential Skyhouse Wing looks over the Atlantic Ocean, Edgartown Harbor, Edgartown Lighthouse and Chappaquiddick Island.
The hotel overlooks Edgartown Lighthouse, Edgartown Harbor and the Atlantic Ocean.
The Captain's Cottages are stand-alone Victorian homes with one to three bedrooms, kitchenettes and living rooms, set along a blossom-filled walkway.
In 1975 Steven Spielberg and the cast and crew of Jaws stayed on an entire floor of the hotel.
The Roxana is named after owner Bernard Chiu's daughter, and its balconies overlook the pool scene and Edgartown Village.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes Martha's Vineyard is a seasonal destination with limited winter availability.
WhataHotel notes the island location requires ferry transportation.
